title: 第一卷 第11章 打通任督二脉第一卷 第12章 墨玄花
slug: 徒儿下山祸害你七个师姐去吧
content_zh:
;;
叶青云现在没法和叶倩文住一起。
高强自然不会放弃这个奉承的好机会。
直接送了叶青云一套江宁市最好的山顶别墅！
天字一号别墅！
“叶少，到了。”
高强将车停稳后，恭敬的对叶青云说道。
叶青云一下车，就看见面前的豪华别墅群。
“叶少，山顶的那一栋就是我送你的别墅。
天字一号别墅，市场价值过亿。”
高强用手指着半山腰的一栋豪华别墅，开口道。
他的心中带有一点不舍。
这云苑别墅区最豪华的天字一号别墅，他是今日才得到的。
原本是想自己享受的。
现在他一晚没住，就直接送给了叶青云。
不过，高强心中是心甘情愿的。
一栋别墅能让自己得到地下王者的宝座。
这实在是太值了！
叶青云顺着高强的手看去。
虽然此时已是深夜。

但，这别墅一路都是有路灯的，灯火通明。
叶青云看见半山腰有一栋豪华的别墅。
光是看一眼，就知道价值不菲。
只不过……
叶青云看见那栋天字一号别墅后，眼神微眯。
那里明显有不干净的东西啊！
叶青云眼中金光一闪，在他修炼的一门瞳术——洞察之眼的观察下。
可以清楚地看见别墅的周围萦绕着一股浓浓的黑气。
邪气！
这种邪气乃是一种邪祟之气，一旦被普通人吸入。
轻则全身瘫痪，重则当场暴毙！
按理说，像这种价值别墅群是找专业的山水师勘察过的。
所选地段绝对是风水宝地。
绝对不可能会产生邪气！
有人在暗中搞鬼！
叶青云心中很快有了定夺。
他把目光落在高强的身上，后者脸上满是谄媚的表情。
叶青云沉声道。
“高强！你好大的胆子！竟然想害我？！”
高强闻言，心猛地一颤。

他唰的一下直接跪在叶青云的面前，额头上冷汗淋漓。
“叶少……我就是你手下忠诚的一条狗，我怎么敢害你？”

Ye Qingyun cannot live with Ye Qianwen now.
Gao Qiang will naturally not give up this good opportunity to flatter him.
He directly gave Ye Qingyun the best mountaintop villa in Jiangning City!
Villa Tianzi No. 1!
"Master Ye, we're here."
After Gao Qiang stopped the car, he respectfully said to Ye Qingyun.
As soon as Ye Qingyun got out of the car, he saw the luxurious villas in front of him.
"Master Ye, the one on the top of the mountain is the villa I gave you.
Tianzi No. 1 villa has a market value of over 100 million. "
Gao Qiang pointed to a luxurious villa halfway up the mountain and said.
There was a little bit of reluctance in his heart.
He only got the most luxurious Tianzi No. 1 villa in the Yunyuan villa area today.
Originally I wanted to enjoy it myself.
Now that he didn't stay for one night, he gave it directly to Ye Qingyun.
However, Gao Qiang is willing in his heart.
A villa can give you the throne of the underground king.
It's so worth it!
Ye Qingyun looked along Gao Qiang's hand.
Although it was already late at night.
However, this villa has street lights all the way and is brightly lit.
Ye Qingyun saw a luxurious villa halfway up the mountain.
Just by looking at it, you can tell it's worth a lot.
It's just...
Ye Qingyun narrowed his eyes slightly after seeing the Tianzi No. 1 villa.
There is obviously something unclean there!
Ye Qingyun's eyes flashed with golden light, under the observation of a pupil technique he practiced - the Eye of Insight.
You can clearly see a thick black air lingering around the villa.
Evil spirit!
This kind of evil spirit is a kind of evil spirit, once it is inhaled by ordinary people.
It can range from total paralysis to death on the spot!
It stands to reason that a group of valuable villas like this would be surveyed by a professional landscaper.
The chosen location is definitely a Feng Shui treasure.
It is absolutely impossible for evil spirits to arise!
Someone is doing something secretly!
Ye Qingyun quickly made up his mind.
He set his sights on Gao Qiang, who had a flattering expression on his face.
Ye Qingyun said solemnly.
"Gao Qiang! How brave are you! You actually want to harm me?!"
Gao Qiang's heart trembled when he heard this.
He suddenly knelt down in front of Ye Qingyun, sweat dripping from his forehead.
"Master Ye... I am your loyal dog. How dare I harm you?"
